architectural_decisions.rationale: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform. It increases the security of the system by reducing the gateways to the outside, since the only way to interact with the microservices is through the Api Gateway.

The platform lacks an efficient storage system that allows saving all necessary data on a large scale and a system that allows us to obtain and analyze this data. The objective of this is to improve the security, scalability and availability of the system.
NestJS allows the creation of a secure and complex REST API in an easier way than using NodeJS directly.
TypeScript was chosen over JavaScript because it is the default language for NestJS and because thanks to its static typing it allows the detection of errors at compile time.
AWS was chosen over other cloud services for its low price and its previous use by the company.

Amazon Athena is a serverless service that makes it unnecessary to manage infrastructure when there is an increase in the data set and users. In addition, to obtain data quickly, Athena performs queries in parallel.
Kinesis Data Streams is used to transmit data in near real-time.
